description: Moves a task's due time (ISO 8601 with offset). A flow-step task shifts its later steps by the same gap, as in the app. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the task, reports what the original call applied, and changes nothing if the task changed since.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: snooze_task
title: Move a task's due time
